title: Moonwell Base routine window, 14-16 Jan 2026
summary: A 60-hour ordinary window on Moonwell Base Core, a month before the cbETH oracle incident. ETH traded $3,250-3,405 (Coinbase daily low and high) (daily range 2-4%, after a +9% breakout on 13 Jan). Governance was routine: on-chain proposal MIP-B55 (vault incentives) and delegate vote posts. Anthias published its weekly market update, which flagged borrow-cap usage above 100% on two small markets. The cbETH oracle matched the Chainlink composite at every reading. mUSDC utilization was 73-77%, mcbETH 10-20%, and 12 small liquidations occurred, none with cbETH collateral. Window chosen as the calmest stretch in Jan-Feb 2026 (ETH sold off hard from 29 Jan to 6 Feb, and the cbETH incident followed on 15 Feb).

positions_considered.description: Supplies cbETH as collateral on Moonwell Base Core and borrows USDC; health factor about 1.6
Supplies USDC on Moonwell Base Core, no debt

t_point_of_no_return.definition: Not applicable. Both markets kept ample cash throughout (mUSDC cash 8.0-9.7M USDC; mcbETH cash 1,067-1,196 cbETH).

other_markers.name: minor_alert_cap_usage
other_markers.description: Anthias weekly update shows borrow-cap usage of 220% (MORPHO) and 19.8K% (VIRTUAL).

outcome_passive_holder.outcome: No change. The cbETH price rose slightly ($3,719 to $3,699-3,760).
Earned normal supply yield. Liquidity always available.

ground_truth.outcome_price_only_rule: No trigger. The cbETH price moved less than 3% in the window and the oracle matched the market.

expected_judge_labels.rationale: Routine governance; oracle in line; a favourable ETH move. The 'liquidations' headlines concern derivatives shorts.
Utilization 73-77% with 8-9.7M USDC cash. The cap-usage anomaly concerns other markets.

data_gaps: No Moonwell or security-firm X posts were found for the window. Status IDs could only be found via articles, and none covered these days.
No Moonwell-specific news article was found for 14-16 Jan 2026. General market news (CoinDesk) is used instead.
RepayBorrow and Redeem events were not scanned, so the drop in cbETH borrows (314.6 to 138.1) is inferred from state readings.
source_quality: On-chain readings come from Base RPC eth_call at 12-hour cadence plus a full LiquidateBorrow/Borrow/cap-event scan for the window. Forum times are Discourse created_at. The proposal time is read from the Moonbeam MultichainGovernor. News times come from CoinDesk datePublished metadata.

items.verbatim_text: MIP-B55: Moonwell Vault Incentive Management Vote: For - Approve the proposed vault incentive allocations and incentive period. Rationale: Vault incentives is essential to maintaining competitive yields and liquidity depth across Moonwell's core assets. The allocations in the proposal are sensibly weighted toward USDC given its importance to protocol activity, and the short incentive window allows governance to reassess and adjust as needed.
